subject: Using published cut-points of Roscoe et al (2017)

messages.author: 494dad402cbbbe7c
messages.subject: Using published cut-points of Roscoe et al (2017)
parts:
Dear Vincent,

Thanks for the release of GGIR 2.0! What was particularly useful in this version was the ability to use published cut-points from various data metrics. 

I wish to inquire about the acceleration metric of Roscoe 2017 for preschoolers. Because the sample frequency was reported to be 87.5 Hz in the paper, should the cut-points be divided by 87.5 (rather than 85.7)? 

Just wish to confirm on this. Thank you

messages.author: 13568954e9b4ef4b
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Using published cut-points of Roscoe et al (2017)
parts:
85.7 Hertz is correct, it was a typo in the Roscoe paper, because GENEActiv does not facilitate 87.5 Hertz. I double checked with the authors and they confirm.
